title: Audit certification acceptance lattice and decision templates for SOC2/ISO onboarding
creator: Asha Menon
description: Create a prescriptive acceptance lattice and standardized decision templates that product, security, and implementation teams will use to validate customer readiness for SOC2 / ISO certification onboarding. This artifact covers SSO/SAML cutover criteria, audit-log delivery and retention acceptance, encryption/KMS requirements, and minimal operational SLOs. Aim is to reduce subjective gate calls during enterprise onboarding and enable faster, repeatable certification signoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Defined acceptance tiers (Green/Amber/Red) for all certification primitives with explicit numeric thresholds
SSO/SAML cutover checklist with success rate threshold: >=99.5% auth success across 48h smoke window
Audit-log acceptance: 99.9% of logs delivered within 2 minutes to customer telemetry pipeline; retention configured to customer SLA (default 365 days)
Encryption/KMS: customer-managed key configured or documented fallback; KMS rotation plan documented
Operational readiness: on-call runbook, escalation path, and rollback decision template attached
Templates exercised by two pilot onboardings and feedback incorporated into final document
tasks: Draft lattice matrix mapping controls -> evidence types -> numeric thresholds
Work with Platform Eng to validate SSO smoke-run metrics and build a telemetry dashboard panel
Create decision templates for: accept, accept-with-conditions, require-remediation, delay-onboarding
Coordinate pilot with Solutions team for 2 enterprise customers (one Hosted, one Dedicated)
Finalize docs and add to Confluence onboarding playbook; notify Sales & Customer Onboarding

2025-11-25 - Design review: Decision templates need a concise one-page summary and an annex with required evidence per control. Design to deliver mockup by 2025-11-30. - Kaito Tanaka (Design)
2025-12-01 - Pilots scheduled: Acme Health (Dedicated, EU region) and Nova Apps (Hosted, US). Solutions will run acceptance dry-run 2025-12-08. - Marta
decisions: Decision 2025-11-20: Use three-tier acceptance (Green: full onboarding, Amber: onboarding with timeboxed mitigations, Red: block) - agreed by PM/Security/Legal
Decision 2025-11-27: Default audit-log retention set to 365 days for hosted; customers can opt for longer retention via add-on - agreed by Product
Decision 2025-11-30: SSO cutover acceptance requires >=99.5% success in 48h smoke and no data loss in audit logs during window - engineering to implement metric collection
risks: Telemetry gaps in legacy auth-proxy could produce false negatives for SSO acceptance
EU data residency constraints may require per-tenant retention overrides and legal signoff which slows onboarding
Dedicated deployments with on-prem networking may not surface audit logs into centralized pipelines without extra connector work

Solutions: run pilot dry-runs with Acme Health and Nova Apps and capture acceptance artifacts
